intro: Xiʼan sits in the Guanzhong basin with the Qinling wall rising immediately to the south, and that wall is the whole story for radio. It blocks everything southward and provides the only real high ground in the region, so the interesting VHF sites are all on its northern slope. The city itself is a major aviation hub with Xianyang to the northwest, a heavy conventional rail junction, and the country’s shortwave time station at Pucheng is only ninety kilometres away — the closest any region on this site gets to a time signal transmitter.
introz: 西安位于关中盆地，秦岭在南侧拔地而起，而这道山墙决定了这里无线电的一切。它挡住了所有南向传播，同时也是本地区唯一真正的高地，所以有价值的 VHF 站点全在它的北坡。城市本身是重要的航空枢纽，咸阳机场在西北方向；这里也是普速铁路的重要枢纽；而国家短波授时台就在九十公里外的蒲城——是本站所有地区中离授时发射台最近的一个。

stations.d: Xianyang is one of the busiest airports in western China and is still growing.
stations.dz: 咸阳是中国西部最繁忙的机场之一，而且还在扩张。

stations.n: No continuous weather radio in China
stations.z: 中国没有连续气象广播
2 米 FM 呼叫频率（IARU 三区）
stations.d: The basin is flat and the Qinling foothills are within reach of the city. From the northern slope you cover all of Guanzhong.
stations.dz: 盆地平坦，秦岭北麓离城不远。在北坡上能覆盖整个关中。

stations.z: APRS 数据 · 一区与三区

stations.n: 无线列调 — conventional railway dispatch
stations.z: 无线列调 · 普速铁路调度
stations.d: Xiʼan is a major junction for the conventional network, and the yards west of the city work continuously.
stations.dz: 西安是普速路网的重要枢纽，城西的编组场连续作业。

stations.z: 高铁 · GSM-R 数字系统

stations.d: Shaanxi traffic radio matters here because the Qinling expressway tunnels close for weather more often than you would expect.
stations.dz: 陕西交通广播在这里很重要，因为秦岭高速的隧道因天气封闭的次数比想象中多。

stations.d: The Muslim Quarter, the wholesale markets and the endless construction sites all run 409 MHz handhelds.
stations.dz: 回民街、批发市场和永不停歇的工地都在用 409 MHz 手台。

stations.n: 公安 350 MHz — encrypted PDT digital
stations.z: 公安 350 MHz · PDT 数字加密

stations.n: BPM — transmitted from Pucheng, 90 km away
stations.z: BPM · 由九十公里外的蒲城发播
stations.d: China’s shortwave time station is in Pucheng County, north-east of Xiʼan. This is the closest any region on this site gets to a standard-frequency transmitter, and it comes in at extraordinary strength on all four frequencies.
stations.dz: 中国的短波授时台位于西安东北的蒲城县。这是本站所有地区中离标准频率发射台最近的一个，四个频率的信号都强得惊人。
